==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. It has almost been three whole months since I first came to the Elven Village. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
To celebrate, Johnson and I used our Lucid Light to fly into the sky above the village. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
We used our power to create a spectacular fireworks show for the villagers to watch and enjoy.
